title: Complete cloud migration for Dynamics SL

facts.text: Disable cloud migration by opening Cloud Migration Management page and selecting Complete Cloud.
Disabling cloud migration deletes environment setup but integration runtime remains.
Integration runtime cloud registration automatically cleans up if unused for couple of weeks.
Create accounts in Microsoft 365 tenant with Business Central license for each on-premises user.
Create Business Central accounts linked to Microsoft 365 email and assign proper permissions.
